_notes:
MEMSensing MSA301 3-axis accelerometer at 0x26 (fixed). 8-bit registers
Detection: PART_ID (0x01) = 0x13
Init: RES_RANGE (0x0F) = 0x01 - 14-bit, +/-4 g; ODR (0x10) = 0x07 - 125 Hz, all axes on; POWER_MODE_BANDWIDTH (0x11) = 0x0C - normal mode (it powers up suspended, 0x9E), 31.25 Hz bandwidth
Poll (100 ms): ACC_X, ACC_Y, ACC_Z (0x02-0x07), each 14 bits left-justified in a little-endian 16-bit value, so read as 16 bits it is 8192 per g at +/-4 g
Source: registers from the MEMSensing MSA301 datasheet; the codes for data rate, bandwidth and power mode checked against Adafruit_MSA301's enums

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-11-08, measuring): the lone 0x99 write and 1-byte read returns 0x00; registers 0x00-0x3F other than the data unchanged and measuring carried on
